content.title: How to watch Rangers vs. Dodgers: TV channel and streaming options for April 12
content.text: The Los Angeles Dodgers host the Texas Rangers at 4:10 p.m. ET on Sunday, a game featuring two of MLB’s most consistent hitters. Andy Pages has an average of .442 (first in league) for the Dodgers, and Brandon Nimmo ranks third at .364 for the Rangers. Roki Sasaki (0-1, 7.00 ERA) gets the start for the Dodgers, who are 11-3 this season and first in the NL West. Jacob deGrom (0-0, 3.72 ERA) is expected to start for the Rangers, who are 7-7 and second in the AL West.How to watch Texas Rangers vs. Los Angeles Dodgers Venue: Dodger Stadium Time: 4:10 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: SportsNet LA and RSN Watching in person? He has a 25% strikeout rate and a 7.1% walk rate in 56 plate appearances, and he has scored eight total runs. Pages has recorded two steals on three attempts. In 63 plate appearances, Freddie Freeman is hitting .259/.317/.483 with a .800 OPS. He has hit three long balls, driven in 13 runs (7th in MLB) and scored seven times. Texas’ Nimmo is slashing .364/.435/.618 this season with three home runs, seven RBIs and an OPS of 1.054 (6th in MLB). He has a 19.4% strikeout rate and a 9.7% walk rate in 62 plate appearances, and he has scored 10 total runs. Nimmo has recorded one steal on one attempt. In 60 plate appearances, Corey Seager has hit four long balls (9th in MLB), tallied 10 RBIs and scored eight runs. He is batting .220/.317/.460 and has posted a 28.3% strikeout rate and a 13.3% walk rate. Seager has recorded one steal on one attempt.
